_comment: Copy this to domingo.json next to domingo.py and fill it in. Never commit the result: it holds your token.
name: my windows pc
token: a secret you make up, at least 16 characters
key: the model server's API key, if it uses one

_fields.name: label shown in the sidebar
_fields.host: what to bind. 127.0.0.1 is the default and the safe one
_fields.token: required by every device that connects. Domingo refuses to bind a shared address, or to advertise one, without it
_fields.url: the model server. Leave out to let Domingo find a local Strata on its own
_fields.key: the model server's key. It stays on this machine and is never sent to a browser
_fields.model: model id to select by default. Leave out to take the server's first model
_fields.advertise: the address your other devices use, when a proxy such as Tailscale Serve forwards to this port
